reserveReview.rationale: The official API updated 2026-10-02T07:06:43.214Z discloses signed main positions and protocol-level assets, borrow liabilities and equity. Net protocol equity shares sum to 99.99%, but protocol buckets do not establish complete asset-level backing weights, hedge reconciliation, custody allocation or a reserve-to-token-liability reconciliation. The signed 17 July 2026 terms define a notional reference portfolio without a requirement to acquire the underlying. Preserve the unresolved NAV envelope and omit compositionAsOf; this research date does not refresh a verified composition.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Rechecked 2026-10-20: the exact mAPOLLO API updatedAt=2026-10-20T22:06:38.135Z reports $47.7210818915 million gross protocol assets, signed borrowing liabilities of -$39.7439162984 million and net equity of $7.9771655931 million. It publishes signed rounded main positions, including USDe and principal/yield tokens against substantial USDC, USDG, PYUSD and USDT borrowing. Protocol equity weights totaling 100% do not provide an exhaustive instrument-level hedge or custody census; positive-position normalization would omit material debt. The recovered latest October 19 SAVE checkpoint contains only issuer NAV/supply, oracle observations and a computed coverage ratio, not signed portfolio holdings or independent hedge reconciliation. The signed July 17, 2026 terms define a notional reference portfolio without requiring acquisition of the underlying. Complete gross/net allocation, custody attribution, hedge reconciliation and the token/pending-liability denominator remain unresolved. Retain the unresolved NAV envelope, absent compositionAsOf, original reserve-review start, 100% known-unknown share and existing 4-day NAV scoring/7-day transport budgets. Fresh dashboard and cryptographic publication clocks do not establish a verified composition, financial assurance or new operational bounds.
